newsitem.title: CHINA: Huangshan prices A shares at 6.02 yuan.
newsitem.headline: Huangshan prices A shares at 6.02 yuan.

text.p: Huangshan Tourism Development Co Ltd has priced its A share issue at 6.02 yuan per share, a company statement said on Tuesday.
The statement said the issue of its 40 million A shares would begin shortly but gave no fixed date. The A shares will be listed on the Shanghai stock exchange, it said.
The Shanghai-listed B share company said earlier that it would issue the A shares in early April.
Of the total, 37.5 million shares will be issued to the public through the Shanghai stock exchange computer network and 2.5 million to employees, it said.
